exposure: Metadata inspected before binding. This project will acquire sealed 2025.zip after this source/time binding; no global assertion that no person has previously seen public data. A source-qualified new external farm, not original WTB E07 continuation.
time_rule: UTC, 10-minute period-END. Half-open issue windows; subtract last issues until final issue+horizon+1-step release is strictly before next stage start. Common forecast publication issue-6, target issue+6. Point fit target publication+12. Issue history requires35 past slots. Missing time/node grid reindexed NaN, never invent measurements.
eligibility: 21 official turbine IDs; W active wind mean, P active power mean kW, Q reactive power mean kVAr, pitch mean of all3 finite blades. Exact source column/schema must be bound from 2023/24 BEFORE test unlock. Ambiguous units, duplicates or unresolvable clock/schema fail qualification; no outcome-based repairs or exclusions.
target_population: Every finite future active-power target, zero/negative kept; no pitch, alarm, operating-state or intervention filtering. Missingness is not performance-based exclusion.
interventions: Keep documented 2023 AeroUp rollout and 2024 TuneUp validation. No date/turbine exclusions based on these interventions or future test performance. Cross-year, control and farm differences limit transfer claims.

training.point_recipe: Original squared-error HGB preset, wind+power36, no future signals
training.models: Same frozen HGB and MLP hyperparameters as development protocol; no 2025-based tuning

candidate_lattice: Common + all7 W/P/Q combinations x last-arrived1/6/36 =22, crossed HGB/MLP; deterministic active-power persistence reference. No target-state probe, graph or MoE added.
pressures: fresh and synthetic 10/20/30/60-minute delays are secondary only, using six fixed development pressure subsets; no industrial frequency or field latency assertion.
calibration: Signed higher-quantile offsets on Jan-Jun2024 only. Historical candidate/offset choice and selected subset/estimator are frozen from Jul-Dec2024 before any 2025 measurement read. Choices use all5 archived seeds and joint paired day-block bounds, allow no candidate.
selection: First require all-instance historical risk upper<=.10. Compare candidate families against all possible-feasible competitors using joint upper paired cost ratios, then choose minimum incremental resource tuple. Primary relative cost tolerance .02 is a declared research noninferiority margin, NOT an engineering validated requirement; 0/.005/.01/.05 descriptive sensitivity. If no solution return no candidate; do not relax cap or margin.
confirmatory_estimand: For the pre-test selected family, all five instance absolute risks plus paired mean cost regret against the historically frozen strongest full-information direct baseline; conditions/competitors and multiplicity must be programmatically bound before unlock. Test-side all-model capability is secondary retrospective, never ex-ante certification.
inference: Shared natural UTC-day moving blocks, primary3day, sensitivity1/7day, B20000 seed20261029; seed instances fixed, no IID turbine or seed replication. Approximate temporal inference; season/control dependence and one farm remain limitations.
unlock_requirements: download MD5 matches publisher and local SHA256 recorded without parsing measurement test
2023/24 schema, units, IDs, UTC end-of-interval and target eligibility independently qualified on allocated node
complete executable preparation/training/selection/evaluation/statistics code with tests and adversarial review committed
all historical target forecasts/scalers/models/offsets/selected candidates and full input/source/config hashes frozen before test read
one unlock event recorded; no performance-driven refit, new period, margin or q grid after unlocking
stop_rules: If raw files unavailable or schema invalid retain DATA GAP; no convenient farm/year substitution
If historical selector has no candidate record no-selection, still preserve predeclared diagnostic outcomes
If independent result fails do not tune on 2025 or rename it validation
No claim of PCC procurement/physical mechanism or universal model minimality
